== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Prophecies]]
** [[Rune Ethercrash]] ([[Spearhead Peak]])
*[[Factions]]
** [[Gao Han of the Rings]] ([[Sunjiang District (Winds of Change)]], only during [[Redemption for the Lost]])
*[[Nightfall]]
** [[Qwytzylkak]] ([[Vehtendi Valley]], only during [[The Killing Joke]])

== Notes ==
* This skill only recharges [[Resurrection Signet]] or [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]] if they were [[disable]]d by another skill (e.g. by [[Distracting Shot]]); it will not recharge them if they were used to resurrect.
* Combines well with [[Symbolic Posture]] or [[Mantra of Inscriptions]].
* Since this skill can and will recharge all signets, including those without any investment in their attribute, consider using [[Symbolic Celerity]] to cast your signets based on your current rank in Fast Casting only.
* Other signets' bonus effects apply before the interrupt caused by Keystone.
* [[Gao Han of the Rings]] is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the [[Redemption for the Lost]] quest allows you to capture the skill.

{{bug|Some non-English descriptions incorrectly expand the [[area of effect]] beyond [[adjacent]] foes: the French full description adds [[nearby]] foes and the German concise description adds the target.}}

{{bug|At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.}}

== Trivia ==
* A [[w:Keystone|keystone]] is a vital piece in a physical or conceptual construction, such as a stone arch or an ecosystem.
